2. It is stated that one Md. Mohsin Khan, predecessor-in-interest of the petitioners as plaintiff on 27-4-1994 instituted Title Suit No. 22 of 1994 for partition. On 9-5-1996, the suit was decreed on contest against defendant Nos. 143, 144 and 232 and ex parte against the rest in the preliminary form. After receipt of the report of the advocate commissioner effecting partition, the preliminary decree was on 25-7-2001 made final. Then, said plaintiff levied the final decree into execution in Title Execution Case No.1 of 2002 for possession. 

 12. The facts which are not disputed are that Md. Moshin Khan on 9-5-96 got the preliminary decree on contest against defendant Nos. 143, 144 and 232 Jalal Patwari. By purchase by two deeds dated 7-1-97 and 3-3-97 opposite party No.1 Mizanur Rahman and his two brothers acquired the entire share of said defendant No. 232 Jalal Patwari which was allotted to him in the aforesaid preliminary decree. The purchasers thereby entered into the shoes of deceased defendant No. 232 Jalal Patwari.
